name: Animal Friendship
summary: A Beast you can see fails a Wisdom save or is Charmed by you for 24 hours.
text: Pick a Beast you can see within range. It makes a Wisdom saving throw; on a failure it has the Charmed condition for 24 hours. The spell ends on it early if you or one of your allies deals damage to it. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot: you can target one more Beast for each slot level above 1.
